answer:
The question asks who killed Harriet Vanger. Based on the passages, **no one killed Harriet Vanger** because she is alive.

The official account stated that Harriet drowned in the sea near Hedeby Island on September 24, 1966 [E1]. However, it was later revealed that Harriet is alive and had been held captive by her brother, **Martin Vanger**, for decades [E2]. Martin Vanger attempted to kill her in 1966 but arrived too late to do so on the island; instead, he kept her imprisoned in a secret room/cellar until she escaped or was found much later [E3]. Harriet herself killed her father, Gottfried Vanger, in self-defense in 1965 by holding him underwater .

Answer: No one killed Harriet Vanger; she is alive. Although the official account stated she drowned in 1966, it was revealed that her brother Martin Vanger had kidnapped and held her captive for decades [E2]. Martin admitted he wanted to kill her but arrived too late to do so on the island that day [E3]. Harriet's father, Gottfried Vanger, was killed by Harriet herself in 1965 when she held him underwater in self-defense .
